title: English Conversation 23:  A Boring Movie
content: 1. I can't understand why...: a sentence pattern used when angry or surprised at something or someone - I can't understand why people spit on the street. It is so dirty. - I can't understand why my boss makes us work late every day. It is unnecessary. 2. at all: a phrase used to emphasize a negative sentence - I haven't eaten at all today. - He doesn't help us at all. He is useless. 3. to not have a sense of humor: to not laugh a lot and to not understand jokes and why things are funny - He is too serious. He doesn't have a sense of humor. - Mary is not fun. She doesn't have a sense of humor at all.
